allowedActions.description: Actions the current user may perform

clarification.description: Open clarification (UC-04 A1), null if none

draftCompleteness.description: Completeness of the draft revision, if any

exchangeId.description: Exchange id shared with the partner's case

lastOutbound.description: Latest message sent to the partner, null if none

part.description: Own part; null while the part of a received request is not mapped (clarification)

allowedActions.description: Actions the current user may perform

clarification.description: Open clarification (UC-04 A1), null if none

exchangeId.description: Exchange id shared with the partner's case

lastOutbound.description: Latest message sent to the partner, null if none

part.description: Own part; null while the part of a received request is not mapped (clarification)

saveMapping.description: Also create the part mapping for future requests (default true)

businessKey.description: Business key of the object at the time of the event, e.g. the part number

prevHash.description: Hash of the previous entry of the same object

requestedAt.description: Time of sending, null while DRAFT

averageLeadTimeDays.description: Average days from request to approval

partnerPartNumber.description: Customer part number that could not be mapped

elements.description: Elements; default: elements REQUIRED at the level

relationId.description: Supplier relation; derived from the part mapping if omitted

hashVerified.description: Whether the local content matches sha256 (own uploads and verified transfers)

id.description: Local document id; null for partner documents until they are fetched and verified

transferError.description: Error code of a FAILED transfer (e.g. DOCUMENT_HASH_MISMATCH), otherwise null

transferStatus.description: LOCAL = own document; partner documents: PENDING, FETCHED, FAILED, NOT_AVAILABLE

transferError.description: Error code of a FAILED transfer, otherwise null

finding.description: Review finding of the customer (interim or of the decision), null if none

values.description: Structured values (any JSON value), validated against the value schema

selfAssessment.description: OK, NOK or NA (NOK/NA require a comment); null clears the assessment

values.description: Structured values (any JSON value), validated against the value schema

valueSchema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of the structured values

edcBpn.description: Consumer BPN forwarded by the own data plane (Edc-Bpn), inbound only

payload.description: PpapNotification envelope as sent/received (JSON), or the raw text if invalid

errorCode.description: Rejection or error code, e.g. REJECTED_UNKNOWN_PARTNER, EDC_CATALOG

details.description: assetId, offerId, negotiationId, agreementId, transferProcessId, httpStatus, cachedEdr, error …

target.description: What the step works on; repeated EDC steps of a pull belong to different targets

targetRef.description: Reference within the target, e.g. sha256 of a document or the submodel id

values.description: Structured values (not read by the current templates)

suggestedMapping.description: Column to target field (null = not imported) as used for validation

action.description: Planned action; absent for rows with errors

elements.description: Elements; default: elements REQUIRED at the level

externalReference.description: Reference of the customer, e.g. e-mail or portal id

partnerPartNumber.description: Customer part number; from the part mapping if omitted

partNameDe.description: German name of the own part (read-only)

partNumber.description: Own part number, alternative to partId

exchangeReady.description: Active and DSP endpoint and DID set (usable for exchange)

roles.description: Roles of the partner from our point of view

requirement.description: REQUIRED or ON_REQUEST; default from the level

kid.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the signing key

ownerName.description: Name of the owning tenant or partner (read-only)

exchangeMode.description: Effective exchange mode of the revision (supplier: how it was provided, customer: how it was received); null for drafts and local cases

payloadHash.description: sha256:<hex> of the canonical payload (SUBMITTED only)

requirements.description: Element code to requirement; missing codes are NOT_REQUIRED

exchangeMode.description: Effective exchange mode of the revision (supplier: how it was provided, customer: how it was received); null for drafts and local cases

shell.description: AAS 3.0 ShellDescriptor exactly as registered in the DTR (incl. specificAssetIds and submodelDescriptors)
